title: PharmAgents2: Towards Autonomous End-to-End Drug Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.07653v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drug discovery requires continuous scientific decision-making across a vast research space. We introduce PharmAgents2, an autonomous system for end-to-end drug discovery that combines knowledge-enhanced decision-making with organized large-scale exploration. Paper2Skill extracts transferable scientific decision knowledge from public sources and, together with expert-developed skills, supports research decisions. Self-Scaling Discovery expands exploration through parallel agents inheriting research context and decision-making capabilities across targets, scientific hypotheses, and discovery strategies. We introduce PharmAgents-Bench v0.1, comprising 121 questions across nine decision scenarios and three end-to-end tasks assessed with expert-defined process rubrics. translated_title: PharmAgents2：迈向自主的端到端药物发现
translated_abstract: 药物发现需要在广阔的研究空间中进行持续的科学决策。我们提出了PharmAgents2，一个用于端到端药物发现的自主系统，它将知识增强的决策与有组织的大规模探索相结合。Paper2Skill从公开来源中提取可迁移的科学决策知识，并与专家开发的技能共同支持研究决策。自我扩展发现通过并行智能体来扩展探索，这些智能体继承研究上下文和决策能力，涵盖靶点、科学假设和发现策略。我们引入了PharmAgents-Bench v0.1，包含九个决策场景中的121个问题以及三个端到端任务，并采用专家定义的过程评估标准进行评估。PharmAgents2在大多数决策类别中优于所评估的基线方法，并在所有三个端到端任务上获得了最高的过程得分。在三项真实世界研究中，系统……
tldr: 该论文提出了PharmAgents2——一个将Paper2Skill知识提取与自我扩展式并行探索相结合的自主端到端药物发现系统，在新基准PharmAgents-Bench v0.1及三项真实世界研究中均取得了领先表现。
en_tdlr: PharmAgents2 is an autonomous end-to-end drug discovery system that combines Paper2Skill-based knowledge-enhanced decision-making with self-scaling parallel exploration, achieving superior performance on the new PharmAgents-Bench v0.1 benchmark and three real-world studies.
